description: BDTRE - Intersezione stradale (IZ_STR) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. It belongs to the theme “Roads”.The “road” is identified as the area for public use intended for the circulation of pedestrians, vehicles and animals. The theme describes both the main and secondary mobility areas and the corresponding graph representation. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "BDTRE — Road Intersection (IZ_STR)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include db topografici, BDTRE, classe BDTRE, trasporti, localizzazioni, GDF. The listing shows 2019-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
